title: Safety Authority: peerless CAN error path (normal mode) - Degraded -> Fault(DegradedTimeout) -> ErrorPassive -> force-stop

rules.name: health_fault
rules.note: health = Fault (3) after T_deg 60s in motion-capable Degraded (CH_F NACK)

rules.name: fault_degraded_timeout
rules.note: fault = DegradedTimeout (1); CanFailsafe guarded (health already Fault)

rules.name: t_deg_accumulated
rules.note: degraded_motion_ms low word grew >= 50s: T_deg 60s accumulation honored

rules.name: stops_issued
rules.note: Controlled stop emitted on Fault (Fault at rest -> CONTROLLED, #45 sec 4); continuous re-emission (D6)

rules.name: force_stops_issued
rules.note: ErrorPassive reached on peerless bus -> FORCE-STOP intent (D5)

rules.name: can_tx_count
rules.note: CAN emission happened (zero/force-stop frames on failing bus)
